coordinateFrame: Each review patch is a local 8 x 8 metre Blender x/y habitat

habitats.label: Damp willow hollow
habitats.premise: Sedges follow a shallow seep; fungi occupy protected wood and root contact.
habitats.placementGrammar: crescent colonies around a wet depression with an open seep

habitats.label: Beech-shade fern colony
habitats.premise: Fern ages radiate away from a mature root flare without forming a ring.
habitats.placementGrammar: one mature anchor, offset juveniles, and a dark litter pocket

habitats.label: Fallen-log decomposition
habitats.premise: Moss, fungi, and ferns track the shaded side of decaying wood.
habitats.placementGrammar: linear succession along one log with unequal colony ages

habitats.label: Sunlit hazel edge
habitats.premise: A multi-age hazel thicket occupies the bright edge while the foreground stays open.
habitats.placementGrammar: asymmetric thicket with one leaning crown and a sparse herb fringe

habitats.label: Root crossing and litter drift
habitats.premise: Exposed root arcs cross the grade; leaves collect on one sheltered side.
habitats.placementGrammar: directional roots and a leeward drift, never a circular ground island

habitats.label: Sparse path shoulder
habitats.premise: Foot traffic and compacted soil keep the path edge broken and mostly bare.
habitats.placementGrammar: small interrupted pockets with no planted border rhythm
